Name: Earthy Inspired Nyapu Portraits
Author: bigsquishy0
Description:
[font=Arial][size=5][center]﻿﻿Earthy-Inspired Portraits (Vanilla + SVE)[/center][/size][center][/center][center]﻿[/center][i][center]﻿A Content Patcher pack that replaces [b]vanilla NPC sprites[/b] with an earthy, warm palette.[b]Winter[/b] and [b]Beach[/b] variants apply when available.
[/center][/i]

[b]Credits[/b]: Portraits by [b][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu?gameId=1303]Nyapu[/url]﻿[/b] (I recolored them to match the earthy palette). I processed all sheets through a custom [b]Aseprite[/b] palette inspired by D[b]aisyNiko’s Earthy Recolor[/b] to unify tones while keeping the original linework.

[b]﻿Features:[/b][list]
[*]Covers most vanilla NPCs and a few special cases.
[*]Includes portraits for SVE.
[/list]
﻿﻿[/font][font=Arial][color=#ffffff][b] Requirements:[/b][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][color=#ffffff]Content Patcher[/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial]SMAPI[/font]
[/list][font=Arial]﻿
[/font][b][font=Arial][color=#ffffff] Installation[/color][/font][/b][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b].[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Download and unzip this mod into your [/font][code][font=Arial]Mods[/font][/code][font=Arial] folder.[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Launch the game[/font]
[/list]
